saw_lines: Fans buy the shirt in the season it launches, then again when the team wins, and often on a phone during match week.
So the sale is won in launch week, when the new kit sits on the homepage beside club news.
Your site headlines the Heimtrikot 26/27 beside club news. Lead the first paid test with the jersey, a first order offer, and a direct link to the shop.
ads_1: Paid test: home jersey 26/27 with first order offer, shop link, against club news
